outcome: Massive hemorrhage during placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) surgery
cohort: 167 women with placenta accreta who delivered by cesarean section at Peking University Third Hospital from September 2017 to December 2019.
finding: The presence of cervical blood sinus, interruption or disappearance of bladder line, the disappearance of the post-placental clear space, and abnormal subplacental vascularity were independent risk factors for massive hemorrhage during placenta accreta spectrum surgery.
